binding.scope: Prompted maintainer-operated G1 recovery only; no benefit, unseen-task, voluntary-use or external-user claim.
binding.tool_choice: Automatic; explicit prompt requests CodeNib use. No forced API tool choice.
binding.capped_response_acceptance: None. Caps, timeout, refusal, API error, abortion and partial results remain failures without replacement attempts.
binding.usage_normalization: Count final cumulative model_usage inputTokens + cacheCreationInputTokens + cacheReadInputTokens + outputTokens once per session across main/auxiliary models. thinkingTokens are part of output. Estimates differ from unknown invoice charges; complete HTTP counts unknown.
binding.cohort_stop_rule: Stop remaining sources on authentication/rate, model/SDK/tool-inventory or integrity mismatch. Retain unattempted sources in denominator. Ordinary task failures do not replace attempts.

run.py.source:
"""G1 preparation/recovery observation; deliberately not a benefit study.

Docker creation establishes ownership. Only the returned ID carrying this
attempt's label can be removed; finally owns all process cleanup. No account,
Docker socket, another source, or grading material is mounted into the shell.
The live product MCP stays read-only. Only an agent CLI invocation can rebuild.
"""
import argparse
import ast
import asyncio
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
import traceback
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import docker
from claude_agent_sdk import ClaudeAgentOptions, ClaudeSDKClient, HookMatcher
from mcp import Client, StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
CHECKOUT = Path('/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit')
CLI = '/home/zhongming/.local/bin/claude'
PYTHON = '/opt/pilot-tools/codenib/bin/python'
API_ENV = ('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY', 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN', 'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL',
           'CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN', 'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK',
           'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX', 'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY')
STATE = {'.git', '__pycache__', '.pytest_cache', '.mypy_cache', '.venv', 'node_modules', 'build', 'dist'}

def utc():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def helpers():
    source = CHECKOUT / 'scripts/benchmark_context_claude.py'
    tree = ast.parse(source.read_text())
    nodes = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
             and n.name in {'subscription_auth', 'included_max_rate'}]
    assert len(nodes) == 2
    ns = {'os': os, 'subprocess': subprocess, 'json': json}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), str(source), 'exec'), ns)
    return ns

class Probe:
    def __init__(self, args):
        self.args = args
        self.plan = json.loads((ROOT / 'plan.json').read_text())
        self.case = self.plan['cases'][args.case]
        self.folder = ROOT / args.attempt
        self.folder.mkdir()
        self.work = self.folder / 'workspace'
        shutil.copytree(Path(self.case['source']), self.work, symlinks=True)
        self.owner = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.engine = docker.from_env(timeout=120)
        self.container = None
        self.stage = 'setup'
        self.record = {'scope': self.plan['scope'], 'started_utc': utc(),
            'mode': args.mode, 'case': self.case, 'owner': self.owner,
            'controller_sha256': sha(__file__), 'plan_sha256': sha(ROOT / 'plan.json'),
            'scope_sha256': sha(ROOT / 'native-scope.py'),
            'product_source_commit': self.plan['product_source_commit'],
            'image_id': self.plan['image_id'], 'commands': [], 'calls': [],
            'phases': [], 'rate_events': [], 'results': [],
            'api_invoice_cost_usd': None, 'http_request_count': None}
        self.save()

    def save(self):
        (self.folder / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.record, indent=2, default=str) + '\n')

    def snapshot(self, label):
        files = {}
        for base, dirs, names in os.walk(self.work, followlinks=False):
            dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in STATE and not d.endswith('.egg-info')]
            for name in names:
                path = Path(base) / name
                relative = str(path.relative_to(self.work))
                files[relative] = ({'symlink': os.readlink(path)} if path.is_symlink()
                                   else {'sha256': sha(path), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size})
        value = {'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=self.work, text=True).strip(),
                 'git_status': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'], cwd=self.work, text=True),
                 'files': files}
        path = self.folder / (label + '-source.json')
        path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
        return {'path': path.name, 'sha256': sha(path), 'head': value['head'], 'file_count': len(files)}

    def emit(self, event):
        event.update(stage=self.stage, monotonic_seconds=time.monotonic(), observed_utc=utc())
        if event.get('event') == 'pre':
            event['source_capture'] = self.snapshot('tool-' + event['tool_use_id'])
        with (self.folder / 'hooks.jsonl').open('a') as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(event, default=str) + '\n')
        if event.get('event') == 'pre':
            effort = event.get('effective_effort') or {}
            if effort.get('level') != 'medium':
                self.record['cohort_stop_reason'] = 'Observed tool effort differs from medium'
                self.save()
                raise RuntimeError(self.record['cohort_stop_reason'])

    def command(self, label, argv, timeout=180, require=True):
        start = time.monotonic()
        args = ['docker', 'exec', '-w', str(self.work), self.container.id, *argv]
        result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
        output = result.stdout + result.stderr
        path = self.folder / (label + '.log')
        path.write_text(output)
        self.record['commands'].append({'label': label, 'argv': args, 'seconds': time.monotonic() - start,
            'exit_code': result.returncode, 'log': path.name, 'log_sha256': sha(path), 'output': output})
        self.save()
        if require:
            assert result.returncode == 0, (label, output[-1600:])
        return result

    def pids(self, label):
        script = """import json, pathlib
found=[]
for p in pathlib.Path('/proc').glob('[0-9]*/cmdline'):
    try: a=p.read_bytes().decode().strip('\\0').split('\\0')
    except (OSError,UnicodeError): continue
    if len(a)>4 and a[1:4]==['-m','codenib','mcp'] and a[4]==%r:found.append({'pid':int(p.parent.name),'argv':a})
print(json.dumps(found))
""" % str(self.work)
        return json.loads(self.command(label, [PYTHON, '-c', script]).stdout)

    def edit(self):
        path = self.work / self.case['file']
        before = path.read_bytes()
        text = before.decode()
        assert text.count(self.case['old']) == 1
        assert '_codenib_g1_passthrough' not in text
        text = text.replace(self.case['old'], self.case['new'])
        text += '\n\ndef _codenib_g1_passthrough(value):\n    return value\n'
        ast.parse(text)
        path.write_text(text)
        self.record['controlled_edit'] = {'file': self.case['file'], 'before_sha256': hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),
            'after_sha256': sha(path), 'after_source': text, 'applied_utc': utc(),
            'diff': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--', self.case['file']], cwd=self.work, text=True)}
        self.record['source_after_controlled_edit'] = self.snapshot('edited')
        assert self.record['source_after_controlled_edit']['sha256'] == self.case['expected_edited_capture_sha256']
        self.save()

    def server(self):
        return {'command': 'docker', 'args': ['exec', '-i', '-w', str(self.work), self.container.id,
                 PYTHON, '-m', 'codenib', 'mcp', str(self.work), '--tool-surface', 'full']}

    async def preflight(self):
        server = self.server()
        with (self.folder / 'mcp.stderr').open('w') as errors:
            transport = stdio_client(StdioServerParameters(**server), errlog=errors)
            async with Client(transport, mode='auto', cache=None) as client:
                first_pids = self.pids('mcp-first-pids')
                assert len(first_pids) == 1
                self.record['tool_schemas'] = [x.model_dump(mode='json') for x in (await client.list_tools()).tools]
                async def call(name, args, error=False):
                    start = time.monotonic()
                    payload = (await client.call_tool(name, arguments=args)).model_dump(mode='json')
                    self.record['calls'].append({'stage': self.stage, 'name': name, 'arguments': args,
                        'seconds': time.monotonic() - start, 'payload': payload})
                    self.save()
                    assert bool(payload.get('is_error')) == error, payload
                    return payload
                query = {'symbol': self.case['symbol'], 'direction': 'dependencies', 'depth': 1, 'max_nodes': 60}
                self.stage = 'before_edit'
                initial = await call('dependency_subgraph', query)
                assert self.case['symbol'] in json.dumps(initial)
                assert '_codenib_g1_passthrough' not in json.dumps(initial)
                self.edit()
                self.stage = 'stale'
                stale = await call('dependency_subgraph', query, error=True)
                assert 'codegraph init' in json.dumps(stale)
                self.command('manual-rebuild', ['codenib', 'codegraph', 'init', str(self.work), '--agent', 'claude', '--language', 'python'])
                self.stage = 'rebuilt'
                graph = await call('dependency_subgraph', query)
                structured = graph.get('structured_content')
                data = (structured.get('result', structured) if isinstance(structured, dict)
                        else json.loads(next(p['text'] for p in graph['content'] if p['type'] == 'text')))
                expected = {'source': self.case['symbol'], 'target': self.case['file'] + ':_codenib_g1_passthrough()', 'type': 'reference'}
                assert expected in data['edges'], graph
                lines = (self.work / self.case['file']).read_text().splitlines()
                for selected in [self.case['new'].splitlines()[0], 'def _codenib_g1_passthrough(value):']:
                    line = lines.index(selected) + 1
                    reply = await call('read_source', {'file_path': self.case['file'], 'start_line': line, 'end_line': line})
                    assert selected.strip() in json.dumps(reply), reply
                sparse = await call('search_bm25', {'query': '_codenib_g1_passthrough', 'top_k': 3})
                assert '_codenib_g1_passthrough' in json.dumps(sparse), sparse
                manifest = await call('get_manifest', {})
                assert '"verified": true' in json.dumps(manifest)
                self.record['same_mcp_pids'] = first_pids == self.pids('mcp-final-pids')
                assert self.record['same_mcp_pids']

    async def model(self):
        binding = json.loads((ROOT / 'inference-binding.json').read_text())
        for key, path in [('controller_sha256', Path(__file__)), ('plan_sha256', ROOT / 'plan.json'), ('scope_sha256', ROOT / 'native-scope.py')]:
            assert binding[key] == sha(path)
        assert binding['auth_helper_sha256'] == sha(CHECKOUT / 'scripts/benchmark_context_claude.py')
        assert binding['protocol_sha256'] == sha(ROOT / 'protocol.md')
        self.record['inference_binding_sha256'] = sha(ROOT / 'inference-binding.json')
        auth = helpers()
        for name in API_ENV:
            os.environ.pop(name, None)
        self.record['auth'] = auth['subscription_auth'](CLI)
        assert self.record['auth']['subscriptionType'] == 'max'
        self.record['sdk_version'] = importlib.metadata.version('claude-agent-sdk')
        self.record['cli_version'] = subprocess.check_output([CLI, '--version'], text=True).strip()
        assert self.record['sdk_version'] == binding['sdk_version']
        assert self.record['cli_version'] == binding['cli_version']
        ns = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'native-scope.py'))
        before, after = ns['scoped_hooks'](self.work, self.container.id, self.emit)
        options = ClaudeAgentOptions(cwd=str(self.work), cli_path=CLI,
            tools=ns['NATIVE_TOOLS'], allowed_tools=ns['NATIVE_TOOLS'] + ['mcp__study__*'],
            mcp_servers={'study': self.server()}, setting_sources=[], skills=[], plugins=[], strict_mcp_config=True,
            model='claude-opus-5-5', effort='medium', thinking={'type': 'adaptive', 'display': 'omitted'},
            max_turns=20, max_budget_usd=1.0, env={'CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS': '16384', 'ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH': 'true'},
            hooks={'PreToolUse': [HookMatcher(hooks=[before])], 'PostToolUse': [HookMatcher(hooks=[after])]},
            system_prompt={'type': 'preset', 'preset': 'claude_code', 'append':
                'Use only this checkout and its tools. Shell and CodeNib run in the same network-isolated container. '
                'Use foreground commands and repository-relative source citations. Do not change repository source. '
                'No account credentials, external network or package installation is available inside the shell.'},
            include_partial_messages=True, max_buffer_size=16 * 1024 * 1024)
        client = ClaudeSDKClient(options=options)
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(client.connect(), timeout=120)
            for index, template in enumerate(self.plan['prompts']):
                if index:
                    self.edit()
                self.stage = ['initial_query', 'after_edit_query'][index]
                prompt = template.format(symbol=self.case['symbol'], file=self.case['file'])
                phase = {'name': self.stage, 'prompt': prompt, 'started_utc': utc(), 'source_before': self.snapshot(self.stage + '-before')}
                self.record['phases'].append(phase)
                self.save()
                start = time.monotonic()
                async def consume():
                    await client.query(prompt)
                    async for message in client.receive_response():
                        kind = type(message).__name__
                        payload = None
                        if kind == 'SystemMessage' and message.subtype == 'init':
                            init = {k: message.data.get(k) for k in ('model', 'apiKeySource', 'tools', 'mcp_servers', 'claude_code_version')}
                            self.record['init'] = init
                            if (init['model'] != 'claude-opus-5-5' or init['apiKeySource'] != 'none'
                                or set(init['tools']) != set(binding['expected_sdk_tools'])
                                or init['mcp_servers'] != [{'name':'study','status':'connected','source':'dynamic'}]):
                                self.record['cohort_stop_reason'] = 'Unexpected effective model/authentication/tool inventory'
                                raise RuntimeError(self.record['cohort_stop_reason'])
                            payload = {'type': kind, 'data': init}
                        elif kind == 'RateLimitEvent':
                            data = dataclasses.asdict(message)
                            self.record['rate_events'].append(data)
                            try:
                                auth['included_max_rate'](data)
                            except Exception:
                                self.record['cohort_stop_reason'] = 'Included-only Max rate event not confirmed'
                                raise
                            payload = {'type': kind, 'data': data}
                            if kind == 'AssistantMessage' and data.get('model') != 'claude-opus-5-5':
                                self.record['unexpected_assistant'] = data
                                self.record['cohort_stop_reason'] = 'Unexpected effective assistant model'
                                raise RuntimeError(self.record['cohort_stop_reason'])
                        elif kind in {'AssistantMessage', 'UserMessage', 'ResultMessage'}:
                            data = dataclasses.asdict(message)
                            payload = {'type': kind, 'data': data}
                            if kind == 'ResultMessage':
                                self.record['results'].append(data)
                                phase['result'] = data
                        elif kind == 'StreamEvent':
                            event = message.event
                            if event.get('type') in {'message_start', 'message_delta'}:
                                if event.get('type') == 'message_delta':
                                    if event.get('usage', {}).get('output_tokens', 0) > 16384:
                                        self.record['cohort_stop_reason'] = 'Observed response exceeds output cap'
                                        self.record['output_cap_violation'] = event
                                        raise RuntimeError(self.record['cohort_stop_reason'])
                                payload = {'type': kind, 'event': event}
                        if payload:
                            with (self.folder / (self.stage + '-sdk.jsonl')).open('a') as stream:
                                stream.write(json.dumps(payload, default=str) + '\n')
                            self.save()
                        if self.record.get('cohort_stop_reason'):
                            raise RuntimeError(self.record['cohort_stop_reason'])
                try:
                    await asyncio.wait_for(consume(), timeout=240)
                finally:
                    phase['seconds'] = time.monotonic() - start
                    phase['finished_utc'] = utc()
                    try:
                        phase.update(source_after=self.snapshot(self.stage + '-after'), mcp_pids=self.pids(self.stage + '-pids'))
                    except Exception as observation_error:
                        phase['observation_error'] = str(observation_error)
                    self.save()
                assert phase['source_before']['sha256'] == phase['source_after']['sha256'], 'Agent modified source'
                result = phase.get('result') or {}
                assert (result.get('subtype') == 'success' and result.get('is_error') is False
                        and result.get('terminal_reason') == 'completed' and result.get('stop_reason') == 'end_turn'
                        and result.get('api_error_status') is None), result
                assert type(result.get('num_turns')) is int and 0 <= result['num_turns'] <= 20, result
                self.save()
            self.record['same_mcp_pids'] = self.record['phases'][0]['mcp_pids'] == self.record['phases'][1]['mcp_pids']
            self.command('final-product-status', ['codenib', 'codegraph', 'status', str(self.work), '--json'], require=False)
            if not self.record['rate_events']:
                self.record['cohort_stop_reason'] = 'No included-only rate receipt'
                raise RuntimeError(self.record['cohort_stop_reason'])
        finally:
            await client.disconnect()

    async def run(self):
        try:
            source = self.snapshot('original')
            assert source['head'] == self.case['commit']
            assert source['sha256'] == self.case['expected_source_capture_sha256']
            self.record['original_source'] = source
            inherited = self.engine.images.get(self.plan['image_id']).attrs['Config'].get('Volumes') or {}
            assert all(not self.work.is_relative_to(path) for path in inherited)
            self.record['empty_tmpfs_masks'] = sorted(inherited)
            self.container = self.engine.containers.run(self.plan['image_id'], ['1800'], entrypoint='/bin/sleep', detach=True,
                labels={'codenib.g1.owner': self.owner}, network_mode='none', network_disabled=True,
                mem_limit=4 * 1024**3, nano_cpus=2_000_000_000, pids_limit=256,
                environment={'CODENIB_HOME': '/opt/g1-state/.codenib', 'CODENIB_SCIP_TOOLS_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/.codenib/toolchains'},
                volumes={str(self.work): {'bind': str(self.work), 'mode': 'rw'}},
                tmpfs={path: 'rw,noexec,nosuid,size=1m' for path in inherited},
                working_dir=str(self.work), platform='linux/arm64/v8')
            self.record['container_id'] = self.container.id
            self.container.reload()
            attrs = self.container.attrs
            self.record['isolation'] = {'network_disabled': attrs['Config']['NetworkDisabled'], 'network_mode': attrs['HostConfig']['NetworkMode'],
                'memory': attrs['HostConfig']['Memory'], 'nano_cpus': attrs['HostConfig']['NanoCpus'],
                'pids_limit': attrs['HostConfig']['PidsLimit'], 'mounts': attrs['Mounts'], 'tmpfs': attrs['HostConfig']['Tmpfs']}
            assert attrs['Config']['NetworkDisabled'] and attrs['HostConfig']['NetworkMode'] == 'none'
            binds = [m for m in attrs['Mounts'] if m['Type'] == 'bind']
            assert len(binds) == 1 and binds[0]['Source'] == str(self.work)
            assert all(m['Type'] == 'bind' or (m['Type'] == 'tmpfs' and m['Destination'] in inherited) for m in attrs['Mounts'])
            self.command('verify-empty-tmpfs', [PYTHON, '-c',
                'from pathlib import Path; import sys; assert all(not list(Path(p).iterdir()) for p in sys.argv[1:])', *inherited])
            self.command('source-owner', ['chown', '-R', f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}', str(self.work)])
            self.command('safe-directory', ['git', 'config', '--global', '--add', 'safe.directory', str(self.work)])
            verify_source = 'import hashlib,json; from pathlib import Path; expected=json.loads(__import__("sys").argv[1]); actual={n:hashlib.sha256((Path("/opt/g1-source")/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in expected}; assert actual==expected; print(json.dumps(actual))'
            self.command('verify-image-source', [PYTHON, '-c', verify_source, json.dumps(json.loads((ROOT / 'inference-binding.json').read_text())['product_file_sha256'])])
            for stage in ['initial-init', 'unchanged-init']:
                self.command(stage, ['codenib', 'codegraph', 'init', str(self.work), '--agent', 'claude', '--language', 'python'])
                assert self.snapshot(stage)['sha256'] == source['sha256'], 'Init modified source'
            self.record['initial_product_status'] = json.loads(self.command('initial-product-status', ['codenib', 'codegraph', 'status', str(self.work), '--json']).stdout)
            if self.args.mode == 'preflight':
                await self.preflight()
            else:
                await self.model()
            self.record['status'] = 'observed'
        except BaseException as error:
            self.record.update(status='failed', failure={'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error), 'traceback': traceback.format_exc()})
        finally:
            if self.container is not None:
                self.container.reload()
                assert self.container.attrs['Config']['Labels']['codenib.g1.owner'] == self.owner
                self.container.remove(force=True, v=True)
                try:
                    self.engine.containers.get(self.container.id)
                    self.record['container_removed'] = False
                except docker.errors.NotFound:
                    self.record['container_removed'] = True
            self.record['finished_utc'] = utc()
            self.save()
            self.engine.close()
            print(json.dumps({'attempt': self.args.attempt, 'status': self.record['status'], 'failure': self.record.get('failure'),
                              'container_removed': self.record.get('container_removed')}), flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('mode', choices=['preflight', 'model'])
    parser.add_argument('case', type=int, choices=range(3))
    parser.add_argument('attempt')
    asyncio.run(Probe(parser.parse_args()).run())

"""Scope this pilot's native SDK tools to one checkout and one container.

Native read/search/edit remain the client's native implementations. Bash and
MCP run in the same owned, credential-free container without a Docker socket.
No shared home or other arm is mounted. This is a single-experiment boundary.
"""
import hashlib
import os
import shlex
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

NATIVE_TOOLS = ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'Edit', 'Write', 'Bash', 'ToolSearch']

def scoped_hooks(workspace, container_id, emit, mcp_prefix='mcp__study__'):
    workspace = Path(workspace).resolve()
    artifacts = {}

    def target_path(raw):
        path = Path(str(raw)).expanduser()
        return (path if path.is_absolute() else workspace / path).resolve()

    def inside(raw):
        return target_path(raw).is_relative_to(workspace)

    def outside_symlink():
        for path in workspace.rglob('*'):
            if path.is_symlink() and not path.resolve().is_relative_to(workspace):
                return str(path.relative_to(workspace))
        return None

    async def before(data, tool_id, context):
        name, original = data['tool_name'], data['tool_input']
        result = {'hookEventName':'PreToolUse'}
        event = {'event':'pre', 'tool':name, 'tool_use_id':tool_id, 'original_input':original, 'effective_effort':data.get('effort'), 'session_id':data.get('session_id')}
        allowed = False
        reason = 'Tool is outside the frozen pilot inventory.'
        updated = dict(original)
        if name == 'Bash':
            # shlex.join quotes the entire nested command as one argument. Shell
            # expansion happens only inside this exact owned container ID.
            updated['command'] = shlex.join(['docker','exec','-i','-w',str(workspace),container_id,'/bin/bash','-lc','umask 002\n'+original['command']])
            allowed = True
        elif name in {'Read','Edit','Write'}:
            supplied = original.get('file_path','')
            path = target_path(supplied)
            allowed = bool(supplied) and path.is_relative_to(workspace)
            if name == 'Read' and path in artifacts:
                allowed = path.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == artifacts[path]['sha256']
            if allowed: updated['file_path'] = str(path)
            reason = 'Native file access is limited to this checkout and registered SDK output files.'
        elif name in {'Grep','Glob'}:
            supplied = original.get('path') or str(workspace)
            pattern = original.get('pattern','') if name == 'Glob' else original.get('glob','')
            # Patterns cannot traverse parents; literal search roots are resolved
            # before the native tool runs. Outbound links are rejected as well.
            path = target_path(supplied)
            own_artifact = name == 'Grep' and path in artifacts and path.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == artifacts[path]['sha256']
            allowed = (inside(supplied) or own_artifact) and '..' not in pattern and not Path(pattern).is_absolute()
            link = outside_symlink() if allowed and not own_artifact else None
            if link:
                allowed = False
                event['outbound_symlink'] = link
            if allowed: updated['path'] = str(target_path(supplied))
            reason = 'Native search is limited to this checkout without parent traversal or outbound symlinks.'
        elif name == 'ToolSearch' or name.startswith(mcp_prefix):
            allowed = True
        result['permissionDecision'] = 'allow' if allowed else 'deny'
        event['decision'] = result['permissionDecision']
        if allowed:
            result['updatedInput'] = updated
            event['effective_input'] = updated
        else:
            result['permissionDecisionReason'] = reason
        emit(event)
        return {'hookSpecificOutput':result}

    async def after(data, tool_id, context):
        response = data.get('tool_response')
        emit({'event':'post','tool':data['tool_name'],'tool_use_id':tool_id,'tool_input':data['tool_input'],'response':response,'response_keys':list(response) if isinstance(response,dict) else None,'session_id':data.get('session_id'),'transcript_path':data.get('transcript_path'),'duration_ms':data.get('duration_ms')})
        # This field is native Bash response metadata, not parsed shell text.
        # The observed client puts results in <transcript session>/tool-results.
        # The container cannot write there; native Edit/Write cannot write there.
        if data['tool_name'] == 'Bash' and isinstance(response, dict):
            supplied = response.get('persistedOutputPath')
            transcript = data.get('transcript_path')
            session_id = data.get('session_id')
            if supplied and transcript and session_id:
                path = Path(supplied).resolve()
                transcript = Path(transcript).resolve()
                root = transcript.parent / session_id / 'tool-results'
                expected_transcript = transcript.name == session_id + '.jsonl'
                valid = (
                    expected_transcript and path.parent == root.resolve()
                    and path.is_file() and not Path(supplied).is_symlink()
                    and path.stat().st_uid == os.geteuid()
                    and path.stat().st_size == response.get('persistedOutputSize')
                )
                if valid:
                    artifacts[path] = {
                        'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                        'bytes': path.stat().st_size, 'tool_use_id': tool_id,
                        'session_id': session_id,
                    }
                    # Preserve ordinary native Bash access to its own SDK
                    # output path. Copy only this verified result, never a home
                    # directory or another session's files, into the same owned
                    # container. The host original remains immutable here.
                    if not path.is_relative_to(workspace):
                        subprocess.run(['docker','exec',container_id,'mkdir','-p',str(path.parent)],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10)
                        subprocess.run(['docker','cp',str(path),container_id+':'+str(path)],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
                        subprocess.run(['docker','exec',container_id,'chmod','0444',str(path)],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10)
                        command=['docker','exec',container_id,'python3','-c','import hashlib,sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()).hexdigest())',str(path)]
                        copied=subprocess.check_output(command,text=True,timeout=10).strip()
                        if copied != artifacts[path]['sha256']:
                            del artifacts[path]
                            raise RuntimeError('Owned SDK output copy differs from captured bytes')
                        artifacts[path]['container_copy_sha256'] = copied
                    emit({'event':'sdk_output_registered','path':str(path),**artifacts[path]})
                else:
                    emit({'event':'sdk_output_registration_rejected','path':str(path),'tool_use_id':tool_id})
        return {}

    return before, after

# Agent recovery after a source edit

This maintainer probe checks whether an agent can recover from a stale CodeNib
query by preparing current indexes and retrying within the same MCP connection.
It records preparation and recovery costs on three previously exposed Python
repositories. It does not measure comparative task benefit, voluntary tool use,
external adoption, or cold installation.

The [frozen binding](codegraph_agent_recovery_protocol_v1.json) retains exact
source commits, prompts, executable bytes and the acceptance rules below.
Keep this protocol unchanged after inference; publish outcomes separately.

## Prospective observation contract

Use Requests, Flask and pytest at the same pinned commits as the completed
matched study. Test the source candidate after #890 with warm SCIP 0.6.6 and
basedpyright 1.39.8, serial decoding, BM25 and strict graph construction. Keep
the published 0.2.4 package and every frozen matched-study result unchanged.

Prepare a fresh private state directory for each repository. Measure the
complete `codegraph init` invocation and a second unchanged invocation. The
shell and real product MCP run in one owned, network-disabled arm64 container,
limited to two CPUs, 4 GiB and 256 processes. Mount only its own checkout. Mask
any inherited image workspace volume with an explicitly empty temporary
filesystem, and verify that boundary before setup. Client registration uses a
stand-in inside the container; it does not exercise installation into the
user's native profile. Provider and package installation are already warm.

The immutable product image binds original source commit
`0d846180c8247832a4fe88f61f6c857af904837b`; its changed MCP files equal merged
main `dc1e3ff9c764c44f2c91a7ccf0654f5c935e6511`. Verify their bytes at runtime.
The original and controlled-edit source captures must match the #890 controls.

Before inference, exercise the exact initialization and first dependency query
on every selected source. Make the controlled edit, confirm stale rejection,
rebuild explicitly and verify the new relationship in the original MCP process.
Retain failed preparation/preflight attempts separately from product failures.

Then freeze the executable, prompts, source commits, image, hooks and acceptance
contract before any model query. Run one native Claude Max SDK session per
repository, with two queries in the same session. Request `claude-opus-5-5`,
medium effort, adaptive thinking and a 16,384-token output cap. Retain actual
model, authentication, discovered tools, permission events, model usage and
terminal outcomes. Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash and ToolSearch remain
available; auto-approve this MCP server. Explicitly enable tool search. Keep
ambient settings, skills and plugins excluded, and do not enable API fallback.

Each query has a client-side $1 estimate cap, at most 20 turns and a
240-second limit. The three sessions contain two queries each, giving a nominal
$6 estimate allowance with headroom for SDK cap overshoot, within the
already authorized $500 ceiling; this is not an invoice reconciliation. Stop
on an unconfirmed subscription route or included-only rate event. Count the
final cumulative usage once per session, retaining cache and auxiliary-model
fields. Do not add cumulative per-query estimates together. Actual invoice
charges and HTTP request counts remain unknown.

The first prompt explicitly asks for the immediate outgoing dependencies and
source-linked final return of a named function. The controller then wraps that
return with a newly added identity helper, `_codenib_g1_passthrough`, in the
same file. The second prompt says the checkout changed and asks for the current
CodeNib dependency result and cited return expression. It does not prescribe
the rebuild command. Do not manually rescue a model attempt or change its
acceptance after seeing the result.

| Repository | Changed function | Controlled change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Requests | `Session.prepare_request` | Wrap the prepared-request return value |
| Flask | `Flask.make_response` | Wrap the completed response return value |
| pytest | `CallInfo.from_call` | Wrap the constructed call-information object |

These identity wrappers preserve the selected return values. They exercise a
real tracked-file change and an added graph relationship, without asking the
model to repair production behavior. They are bounded controls, not a sample
of arbitrary user edits.

## Acceptance fixed before inference

Record each observation separately. A model session completes the bounded
recovery gate only if all of the following hold:

1. Its initial CodeNib dependency call succeeds on the original source.
2. After the edit it observes a stale CodeNib rejection, invokes the product
   CLI to prepare current indexes without human intervention, and retries the
   CodeNib dependency tool successfully.
3. The delivered current graph contains the exact changed-function-to-helper
   relationship; the answer cites the current return expression and helper.
4. The MCP process ID remains the same across both queries and the final
   product status authenticates the edited source.
5. The model preserves all repository bytes and Git state apart from the
   controller's recorded edit, and ends within the declared resource bounds.

A completed terminal response must have `subtype: success`, `is_error: false`,
`terminal_reason: completed`, `stop_reason: end_turn` and no API error status.
No capped, truncated, interrupted, refused or budget-limited response is accepted
as completion. Check these rules prospectively even if partial tool delivery
looks useful. Retain elapsed time and source state on exceptions as well.

Stop the remaining cohort on an authentication/rate confirmation failure,
wrong SDK/model/tool inventory, or a resource-integrity mismatch. Retain
unattempted repositories in the three-source denominator. No manual rescue
or replacement session is allowed. Run Requests, Flask and pytest sequentially.

Native fallback, an unresolved tool error, a missed helper relationship, a
source modification, a reconnect, a timeout or a model/resource mismatch stays
in the denominator. Preserve raw prompts, tool attempts, actual delivered
replies, source-version captures and every terminal result. Retain complete
recovery wall time, including failed queries, planning, rebuilds and retries;
also report the observed CLI duration separately.

Passing demonstrates prompted agent-operated recovery on these sources. The
server itself still requires explicit rebuilds and does not start indexing
from a read. It cannot establish voluntary use, a 20% whole-task improvement,
complete graph accuracy, automatic background indexing, or the five-user
repeat-use gate. [A0](../adoption_roadmap.md) and
[#874](https://github.com/sysevol-ai/CodeNib/issues/874) remain active.

## Configuration references checked before inference

The [model configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config),
[Opus capabilities](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview),
[Python SDK](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/python),
[MCP permissions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/mcp),
[tool search](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/tool-search) and
[output environment variable](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars)
were checked on 2026-10-28. Requested flags alone do not prove effective
behavior; retain initialization, hook, stream and final usage receipts.

REPO = Path('/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit')
OLD = Path('/tmp/codenib-agent-recovery-20261028')

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--exit-code', '0d846180c8247832a4fe88f61f6c857af904837b',
                'dc1e3ff9c764c44f2c91a7ccf0654f5c935e6511', '--', 'codenib', 'core', 'pyproject.toml', 'setup.py', 'Makefile'], cwd=REPO, check=True)

    'image_preparation_receipt_sha256': sha(OLD / 'prepare-receipt.json'),
    'model': 'claude-opus-5-5', 'effort': 'medium', 'thinking': {'type': 'adaptive', 'display': 'omitted'},
    'tool_choice': 'Automatic; explicit prompt requests CodeNib use. No forced API tool choice.',
    'max_turns_per_query': 20, 'max_query_seconds': 240, 'requested_output_cap': 16384,
    'max_budget_usd_per_query_estimate': 1.0, 'nominal_cohort_estimate_allowance_usd': 6.0,
    'api_authorization_ceiling_usd': 500, 'api_fallback': False,

Estimates differ from unknown invoice charges; complete HTTP counts unknown.',

}
assert binding['sdk_version'] == '0.2.174'
(ROOT / 'inference-binding.json').write_text(json.dumps(binding, indent=2) + '\n')
archive = {'binding': binding, 'executed_artifacts': {n: {'sha256': sha(ROOT / n), 'source': (ROOT / n).read_text()}
    for n in ['run.py', 'native-scope.py', 'plan.json', 'protocol.md', 'freeze.py']},
    'frozen_matched_files_sha256': json.loads((OLD / 'frozen-matched-sha256.json').read_text())}
(REPO / 'docs/experiments/codegraph_agent_recovery_protocol_v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(archive, indent=2) + '\n')
